notes.title: DREADZONE v1.5.1
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello survivors,[/i][/b][/p][p]This update is focused on [b]optimization, improvements, bug fixes, and a few changes[/b]. — [b]The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Dreadzone – Upcoming Major Update
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello survivors![/i][/b][/p][p]First, we want to thank you as always for your amazing support and feedback. notes.title: DREADZONE v1.4.5.1
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello survivors,[/i][/b][/p][p]We’re pushing out a small update with a mix of bug fixes, balancing and tweaks.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]interface bug[/b] when interacting with the [b]Furnace[/b] and [b]Repair Bench[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing and tweaking[/b] to [b]item repair costs[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Repair cost is now more affected by [b]current item durability[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug preventing [b]Machete[/b] repairs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]deck collision[/b] and [b]placement[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bug with [b]spike[/b] and [b]arrow traps[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Player’s [b]turrets and mines[/b] will no longer damage [b]their own structures[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]Patrol Helicopter loot drops[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Minor [b]UI element[/b] improvements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing and tweaking[/b] to [b]loot tables[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Increased drop chance for all [b]Falcon-type weapons (LMG)[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧷 [b]Important Note for Pre-Update Save Files[/b][/h3][p]The [b]48-hour grace period[/b] for the durability system transition has now passed.[/p][list][*][p]Any [b]old save[/b] that was [b]not loaded[/b] during that window will now have broken items that must be repaired using a [b]Repair Bench[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]If you missed the window, you can still fix your gear using the [b]FixDurability Beta Branch[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p]Right-click [b]Dreadzone[/b] in your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Properties > Betas[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]FixDurability[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Let the update download, load your save, then [b]quit the game[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Return to [b]Properties > Betas[/b] and select [b]None[/b] to get the latest version with your repaired items[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Happy gaming, survivors![/b][/p][p]

notes.title: Dreadzone Experimental DLSS 4 & FSR 3.1
notes.notes:
[p][b]We hope you're all having a great day![/b][/p][p]We have something new and experimental for those of you who specifically asked for [b]DLSS[/b] and [b]FSR[/b] support in [i]Dreadzone[/i]. While we've tested both options before, [b]TSR[/b] (Temporal Super Resolution) consistently outperformed them in our internal tests, which is why it’s been our default up until now.[/p][p]However, we want to give [i]you[/i] the choice.[/p][p]We’ve prepared an [b]experimental version[/b] of the game that includes:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]DLSS 4[/b] support[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]FSR 3.1[/b] support[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Frame Generation option[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]From our tests, TSR still performs better overall, but your feedback is incredibly valuable to us — especially if you have a different experience on your setup.[/p][p]If you’d like to try this version and help us gather more data, here’s how:[/p][h3]🔧 How to Access the Experimental DLSS/FSR Version:[/h3][olist][*][p]Right-click on [b]Dreadzone[/b] in your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Properties[/b] → [b]Betas[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Under [b]Beta Participation[/b], select: dlss[/p][/*][*][p]The experimental build will start downloading[/p][/*][/olist][p]To revert back, simply change the beta selection to none.[/p][h3]🎮 In-Game:[/h3][p]Go to [b]Graphics Settings[/b] and toggle [b]DLSS[/b] or [b]FSR[/b], then adjust the [b]Quality Level[/b] to your preference.[/p][p]We're looking forward to hearing your thoughts and performance reports — this will help us decide how to move forward with upscaling support in the future.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support,
[b]– The Dreadzone Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 7 DAYS TO EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3][h3]First off, we want to wish you all a fantastic upcoming weekend! 🎉
And most importantly — thank you so much for following Dreadzone and patiently waiting for its release. Your support means the world to us![/h3][p][/p][p][b]We’re beyond excited — only 7 days remain until Dreadzone launches into Early Access! [/b][/p][p][b]Our team is fully committed to making this game the best it can be. And while the launch is just around the corner, we already have major updates planned. This is just the beginning of the journey.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve also noticed a few players expressing concern about PvP. So let us clarify:
[/b]⚔️PvP is completely optional — it's entirely up to the host. You can choose to play in PvE or PvP sessions depending on how you want to experience the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’d like to be upfront about something important: [/b][/p][p]We’re a very small indie team with no external funding, no investors, no crowdfunding, and no pre-orders. Dreadzone has been created entirely through our own effort, passion, and time — without the kind of financial support that bigger studios or publishers often have.[/p][p]Because of that, we kindly ask players to keep this in mind: 🧠 Dreadzone isn’t meant to compete with AAA, AA, or large-scale indie games. We simply want to offer something unique, built from the ground up with a lot of love and ambition. We hope players come in with an open mind and maybe be pleasantly surprised by what’s possible from a small team with a big vision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Again, thank you so much for being here with us.
We’re truly grateful for your support, and we can’t wait for you to jump into the world of Dreadzone next week.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishing you all a great weekend,
— The Dreadzone Team [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505625/8799320853d8469a6823ad42e0c00234b8f53815.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 📢 DREADZONE - 14 Days Until Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]We want to [b]thank you all for following this project and supporting DREADZONE[/b] — we're now officially just [b]2 weeks away from the Early Access release![/b][/p][p]As we approach launch, here are some exciting updates:[/p][p][/p][p]🟡 [b]Turkish Localization[/b]
Thanks to strong community demand, [b]Turkish language support has been added[/b] to the game — this wasn’t originally planned, but your feedback made it happen![/p][p][/p][p]🏆 [b]Achievements System[/b]
We’ve added [b]over 40 achievements[/b] for players to earn — from exploration to survival milestones, there's a lot to unlock![/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]GeForce NOW Enabled[/b]
DREADZONE is now fully compatible with [b]GeForce NOW[/b], so you can play the game from the cloud on supported devices.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Controller Support (Partial)[/b]
Controllers are now [b]partially supported[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Most gameplay actions work with a controller[/p][/*][*][p]However, [b]controller-specific icons[/b], [b]certain functions[/b] like building elevation adjustment, and [b]HUD toggle[/b] are not yet bound by default[/p][/*][*][p]Menus (like settings and main menu) are [b]not fully optimized[/b] for controllers[/p][/*][/list][p]Because of this, [b]we’re not officially listing full controller support[/b], but it’s definitely playable if you’re okay with a few limitations.[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]PVE & PVP Modes[/b]
DREADZONE was originally designed as a [b]PVE-first experience[/b] — and that remains the core focus.
However, due to your feedback, we’ve introduced an [b]optional PVP Mode[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]No access to other player's structures[/p][/*][*][p]No GPS player markers or nametags[/p][/*][*][p]Meant for more competitive survival[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're looking for a [b]cooperative experience with friends[/b], we recommend sticking with [b]PVE Mode[/b], especially since [b]dedicated servers are not yet available[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey.
We can’t wait to see you in the quarantine zones of DREADZONE on [b]Early Access launch day — just 14 days to go![/b][/p][p]Stay alert. Stay alive.
— The DREADZONE Team[/p]

notes.title: Dreadzone Release & New Trailer!
notes.notes: [h3]We would like to thank you for all the support and for your interest in Dreadzone![/h3][p][/p][p][b]We have an important update to share: the release date has been moved from June 26 to July 17.[/b][/p][p][b]This change is due to the Steam Summer Sale starting on June 26, which would have conflicted with the game's launch. Releasing a week after the sale gives Dreadzone a better chance to stand out and also allows us a little more time to polish and add a few more things before the Early Access release.[/b][/p][p][b]We also have a brand new trailer to show you![/b][/p][previewyoutube="eVk2f2swZOo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Thank you again for being part of this journey. We hope you’re all having a great day![/b][/p]
